_sources.brand: From their own yard sign on the listing cover photo: red sign with white 'RLK' lettering. primary = sign red #c41e2a (white 5.9:1), dark = charcoal #1b1a1c (white 17.3:1), accent = light red #ff8a80 (7.6:1 on dark). _sources.reviews: Google Reviews tab, same session: 29 reviews (26 five-star, 2 one-star, 1 four-star off-topic). 3 complete 5-star reviews copied verbatim covering different jobs (angela perfetti: insurance + one-day install, Eric: out-of-pocket + HOA colours, Yates and May Lee: honest leak repair). gap: No website and quotes that slip through: 4.7 stars from 29 Google reviews but 'Add website' on the listing, so every lead depends on a phone call, and one review says an estimate that was promised by email never arrived. A request form with instant confirmation and follow-up would stop that.

realReviews.author: angela perfetti
realReviews.text: We worked with Dustin. He was so responsive and professional. He coordinated with the insurance representatives to file the claim and inspect the roof which really helped. The crew did an amazing job. They got everything done in less than a day! They protected the pool and plants and did an exceptional job cleaning up when they were finished. I highly recommend them and would be happy to use them again!

realReviews.author: Eric
realReviews.text:
RLK really sets the bar high for roofing and customer service.

Robert was very responsive, on time, and communicated very well. He researched the HOA requirements for roof colors, provided samples, and was very straight forward with the process and pricing. The roof was done in just one day and looks fantastic. We paid out of pocket (not go through insurance) and the total cost was very fair.

I would highly recommend RLK to anyone in need of roof work.

realReviews.author: Yates and May Lee
realReviews.text: Jeremy just came out to the house and explained how we didn't need a new roof but just some maintenance from a leak we had from tropical storm Beta. He did a few things and recommendations and I was really impressed and thankful for his honesty. PTL! because I was worried about a roof replacement.

finalCta.headline: Worried about your roof?
finalCta.body: Tell us what's going on or pick a time for an inspection. You'll get a clear answer and a quote before any work is booked.
finalCta.microcopy: No pressure. Just an honest look.

faq.q: Can you help with my insurance claim?
faq.a: Yes. We inspect the roof, take photos and work with your insurance company and adjuster.

faq.q: Do I always need a new roof after a leak?
faq.a: Not always. Sometimes a repair or maintenance is all it needs, and we'll tell you honestly.

faq.q: How long does a roof replacement take?
faq.a: Many replacements are finished in a single day, depending on the size of the roof and the weather.

faq.q: Can you match my HOA's color rules?
faq.a: Yes. We can check your HOA requirements and bring samples so you can choose.

faq.q: What happens after I send a request?
faq.a: Your details come straight through, you get a text and email confirmation, and we follow up to set up your inspection.
